entities.summary: Olli-Pekka Laine is a Finnish musician, currently serving as a bassist in the metal bands Amorphis and Barren Earth (2008–) Octoploid (2024–). He was also formerly part of other Finnish metal bands, Nuxvomica (1990), Rytmihäiriö (1991–1992), Mannhai, Chaosbreed (2003–2005) & Kiljuvelka-70.
